name: mcp-server-comparedge
description: Query verified pricing, independently aggregated ratings, feature comparisons, and category leaderboards for 494+ SaaS, AI, and security tools across 44 categories. Includes 556 curated side-by-side comparisons. Zero dependencies, no API key required.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search SaaS, AI, and security tools by name or keyword. Returns matching tools with pricing, ratings, and features.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get full profile for a specific tool: pricing plans, features, ratings, pros/cons, and similar tools.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two tools: features, pricing, ratings, and key differences.

tools.name: list_category
tools.description: List all tools in a category with optional free-plan filter and sorting.

tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: Get ranked alternatives to a specific tool, sorted by rating.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get detailed pricing breakdown for a tool: all plans, prices, billing periods, and free tier status.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get top-rated tools in a category, ranked by aggregated user ratings.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 44 available product categories with tool counts.
